name: JNE Shipping Official
author: JNE (PT. Tiki Jalur Nugraha Ekakurir)

sections.description:
WordPress plugin integrated with WooCommerce for JNE shipping services in Indonesia.

External Services

This plugin connects to the JNE Official API to provide shipping functionality for WooCommerce stores in Indonesia. By using this plugin, you acknowledge that data will be transmitted to JNE’s official API service as described below.

JNE Official API Service
Service URL: https://shipping.jne.co.id
Service Provider: PT. Tiki Jalur Nugraha Ekakurir (JNE)

What the service is used for:
– Store registration and authentication with JNE services
– Retrieving real-time shipping rates and delivery options
– Creating shipping labels (AWB – Air Waybill)
– Tracking shipment status and delivery updates
– Managing pickup requests and scheduling
– Getting origin and destination location data

What data is sent and when:
– Store registration: Store name, URL, contact details, and PIC (Person in Charge) information during initial plugin setup and configuration
– Shipping calculations: Customer shipping addresses (name, address, city, postal code, phone number), package weight and dimensions when calculating shipping rates during checkout
– AWB generation: Complete order details including sender and recipient information, item details (names, quantities, weights, dimensions), and selected shipping service when generating shipping labels
– Tracking requests: AWB numbers when requesting shipment status updates
– Pickup requests: Pickup location data, preferred scheduling, and contact information when requesting package pickups
– Location lookups: Search keywords or postal codes when searching origins or destinations in admin interface
– Authentication: API access keys and tokens for service authorization

Data transmission occurs:
– During plugin setup and configuration (store registration with JNE)
– When customers calculate shipping costs during checkout process
– When store owners process orders and generate AWB labels
– When tracking shipment status through admin interface or customer tracking
– When scheduling pickup requests for packages
– When searching for origin/destination locations in admin

Data Security and Transmission:
– All requests are sent securely over HTTPS encryption to shipping.jne.co.id
– Data is used solely to facilitate shipping operations with JNE services for your orders
– The plugin does not store sensitive customer payment information
– You must obtain and configure your JNE API access credentials in plugin settings

Service Terms and Privacy Policy:
– JNE Official Website: https://www.jne.co.id
– JNE Terms of Service: https://www.jne.co.id/id/tentang-jne/syarat-ketentuan
– JNE Privacy Policy: https://www.jne.co.id/id/tentang-jne/kebijakan-privasi
– JNE Customer Support: https://www.jne.co.id/id/hubungi-kami

Opt-out Options:
– If you disable this plugin or do not configure JNE API credentials, no data will be sent to JNE
– You can selectively disable specific features (tracking, pickup scheduling) to limit data transmission
– Uninstalling the plugin will stop all data transmission to JNE services

Legal Compliance and Responsibility:
As the site owner, you are responsible for:
– Ensuring you have proper legal basis and customer consent to transmit personal data to JNE for shipping purposes
– Compliance with applicable data protection laws (GDPR, Indonesia’s Personal Data Protection Law/UU PDP, etc.)
– Informing customers that their shipping data will be processed by JNE for delivery services
– Maintaining appropriate privacy policies and terms of service on your website
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ folder
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure settings in the JNE Shipping Menu
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, this plugin is free and open source.

1.0.9

  • Update support email and enhance shipping method labels

1.0.8

  • Fixed: Missing enqueue_awb_styles() method causing fatal error
  • Fixed: AWB CSS file path in method enqueue
  • Improved: Added AWB-specific inline styles for better PDF generation

1.0.7

  • Fixed: WordPress.org compliance – All function names, class names, and hooks now use proper ‘jneshof_’ prefix
  • Fixed: Replaced ‘jne_’ prefixed items with ‘jneshof_’ prefix to prevent plugin conflicts
  • Fixed: Removed duplicate global function definitions
  • Fixed: WP_Error codes now use proper plugin prefix
  • Improved: Enhanced plugin naming conventions for better WordPress.org compliance

1.0.6

  • Changed: API base domain from https://jne-api.krb.co.id to official JNE API https://shipping.jne.co.id
  • Updated: External services documentation with comprehensive data usage disclosure for WordPress.org compliance
  • Updated: Plugin headers and documentation to reflect official JNE API integration
  • Improved: Plugin compliance with WordPress plugin directory requirements

1.0.5

  • Version bump to 1.0.5
  • Minor updates and improvements

1.0.4

  • Fixed WordPress coding standards compliance issues
  • Removed debug error_log() calls from production code
  • Enhanced security with proper nonce verification
  • Improved form processing security
  • Fixed README.txt short description length issue
  • Better PHPCS compliance and code quality

1.0.3

  • Fixed barcode and logo display issues in AWB generation
  • Improved data URL handling for base64 images
  • Enhanced security with proper output escaping
  • Updated Font Awesome to version 6.6.0
  • Fixed WordPress coding standards compliance
  • Improved PDF generation with proper CSS handling

1.0.2

  • Fixed class name prefixing to prevent conflicts with other plugins
  • Updated all function, class, and constant names to use “jneshof” prefix
  • Improved plugin security and code organization
  • Enhanced compatibility with WordPress coding standards

1.0.0

  • Initial release
